protocol.gpu_cost_window: last 1000 completed native GPU-timing records; settled view, not a display-FPS measurement

limitations: One six-turn capture per variant; no confidence interval or replicated small-gain claim.
Relative RMS measures post-turn difference against each run’s own settled image, not absolute correctness.
Headless fixed-cap runs do not establish physical display pacing or a 144 FPS floor.
Sampler GPU test verifies controlled integrals, not unbiasedness of the entire cache/denoiser.

convergence.note:
Review post-turn convergence, using each shot's own settled image as a reference.

This is a transient-image difference proxy, not an absolute quality score.
Exposure is normalized within each wall crop. Torch, hands and HUD are excluded.
The motion end is estimated from captured frames, not ffmpeg startup time.

selection.cache: not selected: small unreplicated early-noise difference and extra work
selection.all: rejected: no settling improvement and about 0.51 ms more in final compose
selection.retention1024: rejected: no settling improvement in this return-turn test

retention_activation: Game-generated compute SPIR-V directly compares incremented stale age against uint 1024; no stale-frame configuration-member load remains.
guide_activation: Six shared closest-hit SPIR-V files per scope use chunk-light descriptor set 1 binding 9. Cache scope adds a second ray-bit-20 check; all-path scope has only the emission check.
